name: core_banking__find_member_by_name
title: Find a member by last name and date of birth
description:
Find a member by last name and date of birth. Searches members by last name, picks the one with the given date of birth, and returns their member number and name.
Returns on success: memberNumber, memberName.
May instead answer business_outcome, with code: PERMISSION_DENIED (The operator account may not do this. An answer for the caller, not a fault.); MEMBER_NOT_FOUND (The search returned a "No members found" message for the last name entered, so no member record matched and none could be opened. (learned from probe: a last name no member has))
Reads only; changes nothing.
Replays a recorded, approved procedure with no model; the same inputs take the same steps.

name: core_banking__find_transaction_by_reference
title: Find a transaction in a member's history by its reference
description:
Find a transaction in a member's history by its reference. Opens a member's transaction history, pages through it to the transaction with the given reference, and returns its date and amount.
Returns on success: transactionDate, amount.
May instead answer business_outcome, with code: PERMISSION_DENIED (The operator account may not do this. An answer for the caller, not a fault.); MEMBER_NOT_FOUND (The member inquiry screen reports that no member matches the supplied member number, offering a "New search" link. (learned from probe: a member number that doesn't exist))
Reads only; changes nothing.
Replays a recorded, approved procedure with no model; the same inputs take the same steps.

name: core_banking__lookup_member_balance
title: Look up a member's savings balance
description:
Look up a member's savings balance. Searches for a member by member number and returns the member's name and the current balance of their savings account.
Returns on success: memberName, savingsBalance.
May instead answer business_outcome, with code: PERMISSION_DENIED (The operator account may not do this. An answer for the caller, not a fault.); MEMBER_NOT_FOUND (The member inquiry screen says no members were found for the number entered, so the member doesn't exist. (learned from probe: a member number that doesn't exist)); INVALID_MEMBER_NUMBER (The application rejected the member number as malformed and showed an "Invalid member number" message with a New search link. (learned from probe: a member number the application rejects as malformed))
Reads only; changes nothing.
Replays a recorded, approved procedure with no model; the same inputs take the same steps.

name: core_banking__open_sub_account
title: Prepare a new sub-account for a member
description:
Prepare a new sub-account for a member. Fills in the new sub-account form for a member and stops at the review screen. Opening the account (Confirm) is left to a person.
Returns on success: nothing (it reaches a screen).
May instead answer business_outcome, with code: PERMISSION_DENIED (The operator account may not do this. An answer for the caller, not a fault.); MEMBER_NOT_FOUND (The member search returned "No members found" for the supplied member number, so the sub-account form could not be opened. (learned from probe: a member number that doesn't exist)); DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM (The Open Sub-Account form came back with a message giving the minimum opening deposit, so the below-minimum deposit was rejected and the review screen was not reached. (learned from probe: an opening deposit below the minimum))
Fills in a change and stops at the app's review screen: it never commits (a person does).
Replays a recorded, approved procedure with no model; the same inputs take the same steps.
